messages:
Priya: noticed a spike of tiny-gang preemptions in eu-west1 around 08:05 UTC, several customer jobs restarted.

Mike: timeline? I saw a preempt burst at 08:05.

Priya: log snippet:

Priya: ```
W0830 08:05:12 scheduler.go:421] preempting pod=batch-train-42
I0830 08:05:13 provisioner: scale-up triggered for gpu-pool (4->8)
I0830 08:05:14 kubelet: pod batch-train-42 evicted: preemption
```

Anya: provisioning started but new nodes didn't reach Ready before kubelet evicted local pods. Any AZ mismatch?

Chris: provisioner created nodes in eu-west1-b while pending pods preferred eu-west1-c (strict topologyAffinity). cloud API returned 429 for c; autoscaler fell back to other zones which scattered gangs.

Priya: that cross-zone fallback created GPU fragmentation and many tiny pods stuck on separate GPUs, then preempt waves hit.

Mike: we should avoid preempting when a scale-up is in-flight for the same zone. proposal: a zone-aware "provision_stabilize" window where scheduler suppresses aggressive preempt for pending pods if scale-up exists for that zone. default 30s.

Anya: options: increase provisioner retry for same-AZ (slower), relax strict affinity for tiny gangs (perf risk), or add transient holdback (preferred).

Chris: config sketch:

Chris: ```yaml
scheduler:
  provisionStabilizeWindow: 30s
  zoneAware: true
```

Priya: i'll open a small PR to eng-scheduler and canary in staging with a trace replay. tagging @Chris @Mike for review.

Mike: also emit metric scheduler.provisioner_cooldown_mismatch and create a Grafana panel overlaying scale-ups, cloud 429s, and preemption counts.

ops-bot: alert: eu-west1 preemptions > 40 in 5m

sre-oncall: investigating. 3 customer jobs restarted so far, no elevated 5xxs.

Priya: canary results: preemptions during replay dropped ~75%, Ready latency unaffected. plan: roll to prod with 1h ramp if staging looks good.

Chris: long-term: consider burst/burst-pool to pack tiny pods opportunistically to reduce fragmentation. include cost/latency tradeoffs in RFC.

Priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/842
Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/scaleup/preemptions-vs-scaleups

sre-oncall: tagging incident P2. will update thread.

Priya: closing once prod stable. :white_check_mark:
